o.text:
Likely a calque of Russian словоизмени́тельный (slovoizmenítelʹnyj).
By surface analysis, söz (“word”) + dəyişdir (“to change”) + -ici.
Probably borrowed from Russian барье́р (barʹjér), from French barrière. Cognate to Turkish bariyer.
